title: Susanna, or via, sortite
subtitle: The Count, the Countess and Susanna: terzetto from Le nozze di Figaro, Act 2 (No. 13)
note: The Count orders “Susanna” out of the closet; the Countess forbids it
about: Score: No. 13, the terzetto “Susanna, or via, sortite” (vocal score pages 123-131, 146 bars), from Paul Klengel's piano reduction in the Breitkopf & Härtel vocal score (Edition Breitkopf 1716, about 1900), public domain.
